candidates.name: Necrotizing fasciitis
support_spans: Large and deep, irregularly shaped, cutaneous ulcer on the dorsum of right forearm with necrotic tissue and muscle exposure at the base
candidates.why: Presence of necrotic tissue and muscle exposure at the base of the ulcer

candidates.name: Scleroderma
support_spans: Woody induration of skin on both forearms and abdominal region
candidates.why: Presence of woody induration of skin

candidates.name: Scleroderma
support_spans: Severe fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa
candidates.why: Presence of severe fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa

candidates.name: Eosinophilic fasciitis
support_spans: Bilateral contracture of deltoid, triceps, and biceps muscles
candidates.why: Presence of bilateral contracture of muscles

candidates.name: Lipodermatosclerosis
support_spans: Lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes and dense inflammatory infiltrates composed mainly of foamy histiocytes
candidates.why: Presence of lobular panniculitis and necrotic adipocytes

candidates.name: Foreign body granuloma
support_spans: Foreign-body giant cells and macrophages with large, foamy cytoplasm present
